title: Managed worktree lacks the current source baseline
context_notes: Dogfooding FEAT-LOCAL-INIT showed that the claimed worktree is a valid Git checkout at the old base commit, but it lacks the current VibeSync sources because those files are untracked outside the repository Git root. Do not copy or commit the user working tree implicitly. Add an explicit readiness diagnostic and a safe baseline strategy before claiming source-edit tasks.
